# Erin Northcott

Erin Northcott is a Canadian documentary producer and somatic coach based on Vancouver Island, British Columbia. She spent eleven years carrying her younger brother Daniel Northcott's archive of footage into *Daniel*, an HBO Original documentary produced with Adam McKay, after Daniel died at twenty-nine and asked her to finish the film he had been shooting around the world. That work became the ground for a second practice: Inner Ceremonies, private one-to-one somatic sessions held online with clients worldwide, drawing on somatic therapy, parts work, inner child work, hypnotherapy, NLP, breathwork and the ancient teachings of tantra. The sessions are medicine- and substance-free, and the work is ceremonial in feeling, grounded in the body, and rooted in the bond between people and the earth.

- [Home](https://erinnorthcott.com/): Who Erin is, the film, and the two halves of her work: documentary production and somatic coaching.
- [Daniel](https://erinnorthcott.com/daniel/): The story of her brother Daniel Northcott, the pact between them, and how his footage became an HBO Original documentary. Includes the trailer, where to watch, and press.
- [Inner Ceremonies](https://erinnorthcott.com/inner-ceremonies/): Her somatic coaching practice. What happens in a session, the three pillars of the work, client experiences, ways to work together with pricing, and a full FAQ.
- [Book](https://erinnorthcott.com/book/): A placeholder for the book Erin is writing. No content yet.
- [Connect](https://erinnorthcott.com/connect/): How to reach Erin, for a consultation call or to bring her a story, a gathering or a project.
